about: By hand: the EU core legislation the graph holds whether or not a Dutch regulation names it, a choice of scope: no source lists the core of EU law. EUR-Lex and the Publications Office name an act by CELEX number; the text is retrieved from CELLAR (`retrieve eurlex --mode gaps` fetches every act here that the graph does not hold), never entered by hand. `title` is the Dutch title CELLAR gave on the day the number was checked against `source`. An act CELLAR does not hold stays a gap in `lawgraph gaps`. `lawgraph curated set eu-core`.
